properties.description: Existing root task remains waiting on review; review tasks are excluded from board. Coherent candidate identity, evidence and multi-repository review at top of timeline. Review preview and annotate inside Broccoli, iterate without losing feedback. Scheduled debt audits/reactive bug investigation are configurable and traceable; findings-only default pending later policy changes. No automatic merge or user acceptance. Reproduce asynchronous selection/context bug before fix.
properties.title: Deliver reliable task execution and review iteration across the buildspace
